Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Allowed: - Zidovudine (AZT) for patients with AIDS. - AIDS related complex (ARC).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description does not mention HIV, AIDS, or ARC. No evidence of AIDS-related complex or AZT use.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: The presence of any one of the following findings within 12 months prior to entry... - Fever of > 38.5 degrees C persisting for longer than 3 weeks. - Involuntary weight loss of > 15 lbs. or > 10 percent of baseline noted in a 120-day period prior to evaluation. - Diarrhea (> 2 liquid stools per day) persisting for longer than 1 month. - History of clinical diagnosis of oral candidiasis or hairy leukoplakia. - Patients who have AIDS-associated opportunistic infections or tumors.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has no documented fever, weight loss, diarrhea, oral candidiasis, hairy leukoplakia, or AIDS-associated opportunistic infections/tumors.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients eligible for AZT under the labeling.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of HIV/AIDS or AZT eligibility in patient history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: A positive HIV antibody test. Exceptions will be made for patients with a previously positive HIV antibody test with progressive disease and patients where virus isolation has been made.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description does not specify HIV antibody status or virus isolation data.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient with stable Kaposi's sarcoma, mild herpes infection, mild or stable depression, asymptomatic or mild cytomegalovirus or Epstein-Barr virus infection, or a hepatitis B virus carrier state will be acceptable for study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of Kaposi's sarcoma, herpes, depression, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, or hepatitis B carrier status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: A life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description does not address life expectancy or prognosis for HIV/AIDS-related conditions.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with the following are excluded: - Severe ongoing opportunistic infections including Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia (PCP), cryptococcal or toxoplasmosis meningo-encephalitis, disseminated herpes simplex or herpes zoster.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of severe opportunistic infections in patient history.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Significant diarrhea at entry ( > 1 watery stool per day).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No documentation of diarrhea in patient description.
No mention of phenytoin use in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Excluded within 30 days of study entry: - Other antiretroviral agents or immunomodulating agents.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of antiretroviral or immunomodulating agent use within 30 days of study entry.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient has demonstrated prior sensitivity or has experienced significant adverse effects during prior therapy with the drugs to be used in the study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information provided about prior drug therapy or adverse effects related to study drugs.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient cannot abstain from alcohol or any other drugs, including nonprescription medication, during the study period.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description does not address alcohol or drug use during the study period.

Recap: Patient lacks evidence of HIV/AIDS, AIDS-related complex, or required clinical findings (fever, weight loss, diarrhea, opportunistic infections). No documentation of AZT eligibility, HIV antibody status, or life expectancy. Exclusion criteria for severe opportunistic infections, diarrhea, and concurrent medications are not violated.
